items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: The road manager, Sully, came up and paid me half of my salary

ctx.x: Yeah, Sully. The road manager, Sully, came up and paid me half of my salary, which was another thing that didn't happen in Cab's band, because in Cab Calloway's band, he had two envelopes -- a white one and a blue one, and the blue one, in fact, before I tell you about the blue one, he used to always tell you, "Don't grumble on stay; and and stage, grumble or be on your way or wait until Thursday -- that was payday in Cab's band.

Now if you got a blue envelope, you knew you had two more weeks to go, but if you got that white envelope, there was a ticket in there, 9 out of 10 times, there was a ticket in there and your notice to leave.
